## Lavanda 1.0.3

This release completes GNOME Shell 51 compatibility and fixes several style gaps found in a full audit against the upstream `gnome-51` theme.

### GNOME Shell 51

- Lock-screen media notifications now use the `.message` component introduced in GNOME Shell 51 (previously only `.notification` was styled).
- Login prompt layout aligned with upstream GNOME Shell 51 (`30em` width, `550px` height); removed the unused `.web-login-active` selector.
- Restored panel status indicator spacing (`.panel-status-indicators-box`) and added the light-variant panel border.
- Matched upstream 51 details: entry hint spacing, message-list bottom padding, world clock alignment, caps-lock warning label, "not listed" button and logged-in user icon.

### Build

- `build.sh` now detects the installed GNOME Shell version and compiles the matching style branch, just like `install.sh`.

### Documentation

- Documented that the GDM login screen needs separate configuration.

### Installation

Download the source archive, extract it, and run:

```sh
./install.sh
```

The script detects the installed GNOME Shell version and compiles the matching styles.
